The 'texture_anomaly' (severity 1.5) regarding the plastic sheen is actually a faithful representation of synthetic wigs, so I will downgrade its impact on the artifact score, treating it as a material property rather than a generation error. The background blur is consistent with depth-of-field, though the painterly quality noted by the Router is a mild AI tell. The Perceptual Quality Auditor found no graphics-level distortions, which supports the high clarity of the main subject.

The only minor deduction is that the 'natural growth' coloration checkpoint is a weak match due to the solid fashion color, but this is inherent to the specific wig style shown. Structural conformance to cranial curvature is excellent.

The hair texture is very sharp and distinct (supported by high SAM mask confidence 0.98), avoiding the common 'melting hair' artifact. The 'plastic' look is authentic to synthetic wigs.
